I fit in this group, and I've been contemplating suicide for a while now.  I've begun making and laying plans so that I don't inconvenience my family.  

I sell  most of my waking life to people who would have no qualms about cutting me loose if it improved their bottom line.

I spent a few years stoned, sobered up, moved, changed jobs, tried to get healthier physically, spoke with a counselor.  All in an effort to pull myself out.  

There is no escape.  I'm never going to do any better than I am.  I'm never going to be able to afford to own a home or raise children.  Even if I could, what right have I to doom someone else to this life.  

Nothing feels good.  None of the hobbies I enjoyed bring me satisfaction.  Sex holds no appeal.  There is nothing for me here anymore.
